scoring_justification: The lattice energy is a single aggregate value; the checker verifies it against the paper-reported value (-25.10 kJ/mol) using an absolute tolerance and linear decay, as a full re-simulation is not feasible within the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 6 and main text: half-sum of pair potentials = -25.099 kJ/mol, reported E_latt = -25.10 kJ/mol.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken from the paper's reported value and stored inline in grading_spec.json.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The paper-reported crystallographic lattice energy is the authoritative target for reproduction.

schema.description: A single decimal number representing the half-sum of pair potentials over the 19 neighbors.

outputs.description: Reproduced lattice energy of orthorhombic acetylene crystal using the ellipsoidal Kihara core plus spheroidal quadrupolar interaction model.

output_contract.notes: The exact tolerance is hidden. The agent must compute the energy from first principles; the hidden gold is the paper-reported value.
